label: Zalo
terms_note: Requires a verified Zalo Official Account on a paid OA package (Basic / Growth / Premium — API messaging features scale with the package); OAuth v4 at oauth.zaloapp.com/v4/oa (access token ~25 h, refresh ~3 months per earlier research research; not re-read today); consultation (tư vấn) messages only within 48 h of the user's last message; transaction / promotion messages via paid ZNS templates; article broadcasts capped (≤ 4 per follower per month per earlier research research).

config_fields.name: author
config_fields.help: Author name shown on OA articles (≤50 characters).

config_fields.name: cover_photo_url
config_fields.help: URL of the cover photo used for text articles (the article API requires a cover).

fields.name: app_id
fields.help: ID of your Zalo app (developers.zalo.me > app > Thông tin ứng dụng).

fields.name: secret_key
fields.help: The app's secret key (Khóa bí mật của ứng dụng); sent only as the secret_key header of the token request.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: OA refresh_token from the OA authorisation (POST https://oauth.zaloapp.com/v4/oa/access_token with grant_type=authorization_code). Valid 3 months and single-use: each refresh returns a new one that replaces it (persisted when PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR is set). Access tokens last 25 h.

me.note: GET /v2.0/oa/getoa: the OA's id, name, description, is_verified, num_follower, package.

publish_text.note: POST /v2.0/article/create (type normal, status show) publishes an OA article whose title, description and body are `text` — so `text` must be ≤150 characters (title limit; description ≤300) — with the configured author and cover photo. Creation is asynchronous: the returned `id` is the creation token; POST /v2.0/article/verify {token} gives the article id that delete takes. reply_to is ignored.

publish_image.note: POST /v2.0/article/create: an OA article with `text` as title/description/first paragraph (≤150 characters; required here) and the FIRST of `image_urls` as both cover and image paragraph (further URLs are ignored: the adapter cannot emit a variable number of paragraphs). `id` is the creation token (resolve with /v2.0/article/verify).

delete.note: POST /v2.0/article/remove {id}: deletes an OA article by its article id (from /v2.0/article/verify or /v2.0/article/getslice).

not_offered.read_comments: The OA content APIs (https://stc-developers.zdn.vn/docs/v2/official-account/noi-dung/noi-dung-dang-bai-viet/: create, verify, getdetail, getslice, remove, update) expose no article comments.
not_offered.reply_comment: No comment API exists for OA articles (https://stc-developers.zdn.vn/docs/v2/official-account/noi-dung/noi-dung-dang-bai-viet/).
not_offered.read_mentions: The Official Account API has no mentions feed (https://developers.zalo.me/docs/official-account/noi-dung/tong-quan).
not_offered.analytics_post: Per-article statistics are only total_view / total_share inside the paged list GET /v2.0/article/getslice (https://stc-developers.zdn.vn/docs/v2/official-account/noi-dung/noi-dung-dang-bai-viet/lay-danh-sach-noi-dung-dang-bai-viet), which cannot be filtered by id; GET /v2.0/article/getdetail returns no counts.

adapter.terms: Zalo Official Account API (https://developers.zalo.me/docs/official-account/): every call carries the OA access_token header; failures are {error: <non-zero>, message} in 200 bodies. Access tokens (25 h) are minted from the rotating single-use refresh token at https://oauth.zaloapp.com/v4/oa/access_token (form refresh_token, app_id, grant_type; secret_key header; https://stc-developers.zdn.vn/docs/v2/official-account/bat-dau/xac-thuc-va-uy-quyen-cho-ung-dung-new).

evidence: host openapi.zalo.me: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (DigiCert Inc)
